The effective federal funds rate was 4.09% on October 1, 2025, and the top of the target range was 4% at the time of the meeting. [2025-10-29/policyAction/18] and [2025-10-29/policyAction/2].

cases.question: Where did policymakers set the fed funds target range after their December 2025 meeting?
cases.answer: According to the minutes of the meeting that ended on 2025-12-10, policymakers set the federal funds target range at 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent. This decision was made in support of the Committee's goals, considering the shift in the balance of risks. The vote was 9 in favor and 3 against, with Jerome H. Powell and John C. Williams leading the former group, and Stephen I. Miran and Austan D. Goolsbee leading the latter. [2025-12-10/policyAction/19, 2025-12-10/policyAction/2]
